description: Five synthetic CVs and 25 gold questions. Retrieval searches every CV, so a hit means the right passage was found. People and employers are fictional.

documents.label: Short CV
documents.text:
LINA COSTA
Casablanca
Nurse at Clinique Atlas since 2023. Two years of ward experience. Speaks French and Arabic. No email address is printed on this CV.

documents.label: Long CV
documents.text:
YOUSSEF BENALI
Rabat, Morocco
Data engineer with eight years of experience building batch and streaming pipelines.

SUMMARY
Youssef designs warehouse models, schedules jobs, and reviews data quality with analysts. He writes in Python and SQL and prefers documented handovers.

SKILLS
Spark, Airflow, PostgreSQL, and dbt. He does not list Kafka.

EXPERIENCE
CIMR, Rabat — Data engineer, 2022 to present.
Owns the member-contributions lakehouse. Moved nightly Spark jobs from a single virtual machine onto a small cluster. Added dbt tests for duplicate national identifiers. Partners with the finance squad every Monday.

Inwi, Casablanca — Data engineer, 2018 to 2022.
Built Airflow pipelines for prepaid usage. Cut a failing 6-hour job into tasks that finish before 7am. Mentored two junior analysts on SQL reviews.

OCP Group, internship, 2016 to 2018.
Cleaned maintenance-report spreadsheets for the Khouribga site and loaded them into PostgreSQL. Did not work on mine planning.

EDUCATION
EMI Rabat, engineering diploma, 2016. Final project: a complaint-classification prototype for a municipal hotline.

OTHER
Notice period is two months. He has no AWS certification. Salary is not written on this CV. He has no public GitHub account.

documents.label: Unusual layout
documents.text:
SKILLS FIRST
Figma, illustration, Arabic and French typography.

SELECTED WORK
In 2021 Nora redesigned the paper bus ticket for the fictional carrier Alsa Nord.
The new ticket used a larger route number and a quieter color for night lines.

STUDIES
Ecole Supérieure des Beaux-Arts, Toulouse, diploma 2015.

NAME AND CONTACT — read last
Nora El Idrissi, freelance designer in Tangier.
Portfolio: nora.studio
No phone number is printed.

documents.text:
